decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building(s) is/are occupied/used).

Condition : 3 - 3- The parking, loading and turning spaces shown on drawings numbered either 2575/20 or 2575/21 shall be constructed and laid out for use before the commencement or occupation of any part of the building for light industrial use (Class B1c) and shall not be used for any other purpose.

Condition : 4 - 4- The parking, loading and turning spaces shown on drawings numbered either 2575/22 or 2575/23 shall be constructed and laid out for use before the commencement or occupation of any part of the building for general industrial use (Class B2) and shall not be used for any other purpose.

Condition : 5 - 5- The parking, loading and turning spaces shown on drawings numbered either 2575/22 or 2575/23 shall be constructed and laid out for use before the commencement or occupation of any part of the building for storage and distribution uses (Class B8) and shall not be used for any other purpose.

Condition : 6 - The main entrance doorways in these units shall each have a minimum clear width of 900mm, a level surface or ramp between the parking bays, the pavement and the ground floor and door handles not exceeding 1m above ground level.
description: Permission for flexible use from B8 Warehousing/Distribution to either B1(c) Offices or B2 General Industrial; or B8 Warehousing/Distribution.
